name: sakai
key_challenge: Lower-error regime (8%, HiFi-polished-like); second bacterial genome with prophage/IS repeat content

reference.notes: Chromosome only; plasmids pO157 (NC_002128) and pOSAK1 are excluded.

simulation.notes: read_error is the per-base error-EVENT rate (substitutions + indel events); indel events average ~2 bp, so base-level edit divergence is ~1.7x the stated value.

truth.simulated: reads_1.fq.truth.tsv beside the reads: read_id chrom true_start strand true_end n_subs n_ins n_del indel_events. true_start is the 0-based leftmost reference coordinate; true_end is half-open. Score placement within +/-100 bp (long_read_accuracy.py).

benchmark_notes: Sakai carries ~18 prophages and many IS elements, so it has more intragenomic repeats than MG1655.
